en: Colorized winter landscape of an alpine village in a valley, surrounded by dense evergreen forests and dramatic jagged mountains. Snow covers the roofs and trees; several multi‑story hotels or lodges are visible, suggesting a ski resort. The sky is bright blue with scattered white clouds, and there is a scalloped decorative border around the image, typical of vintage postcards.
